description: Individual settled tactica. picks, 20 per page, newest first: match, kick-off, league, selection, market, tier, outcome and score. Picks only: no odds or per-pick profit. Use this when you need pick-by-pick detail, for example to audit the record. Use get_track_record instead (free) for totals by market, league and tier. Read-only; every pick settled to date, with an observedAt time. A page past the end returns an error with the page count. Paid: 1.00 USDC per page, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

page.description: Optional, default 1. Page number, an integer from 1; 20 settled picks per page, and every reply gives the total number of pages. Example: 2

name: get_settled_record
title: Get settled picks
